name: tiny
summary: A voice + touch agent surface for reTerminal Sticky — your tiny.technology agent, on e-ink, in your pocket.
description: tiny turns reTerminal Sticky into a body for one personal agent: hold the AI button and speak, or type on the on-glass keyboard, and the answer streams onto the e-ink and stays there. The agent composes cards (text, list, key/value, menu, QR, chart, chat, composite, image, gallery) that the firmware renders natively in four grays; taps flow back as events. Requires a free tiny.technology account — the device holds only a revocable device token, never an account credential. Includes first-run onboarding on the glass (Wi-Fi via phone QR or on-device scan + keyboard, pairing, a short tour), sha256-pinned A/B OTA with rollback, IMU pocket-lock and auto-rotate, deep sleep with the last card left on the glass, a microSD gallery, and a local shell that works without the network.

compatibility.notes: reTerminal Sticky production hardware (ESP32-S3R8, 32 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM). Needs 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and a tiny.technology account. Installing erases the whole flash, including Seeed's factory demo — dump it first if you want it back (docs: Recovery).

assets.previewAlt: tiny's home screen on reTerminal Sticky — the real 800×480 framebuffer with the agent conversation canvas, glance cluster and message bar

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB-C data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge. Pick the port called "USB Single Serial" (the CH343 bridge, no driver needed).

notes.title: Clean installation
notes.description: Accept the erase prompt. The first install wipes the whole flash including Seeed's factory demo (dump it first if you want it back — see Recovery in the docs) and starts with an empty settings store. From then on updates arrive over the air into the other A/B slot with rollback.

notes.title: First boot: Wi-Fi and pairing on the glass
notes.description: The device walks you through setup on its own screen: scan the QR with your phone to join the tiny-XXXX setup network (password tinysetup) and open http://192.168.4.1, or tap "Type it here" to pick a network from the on-glass scan list and type the password on the e-ink keyboard. Then pair it to your tiny.technology account and take the one-screen tour. No app required.

notes.title: What it needs
notes.description: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and a tiny.technology account (free). The intelligence runs server-side; without Wi-Fi the device keeps its local pages (home, status, sensors, settings, gallery) and the last card on the glass, but cannot answer questions.
